Michael Addison

United Citizens candidate for Governor and Lieutenant Governor, South Carolina · Open seat

Physician and medical director

Dr. Michael Addison is a physician and medical director running for governor of South Carolina as the United Citizens Party nominee, with Dr. Candace Brewer as his running mate for lieutenant governor. He was the only United Citizens candidate to file for governor before the March 30, 2026 deadline, so his name did not appear on the June primary ballot. He is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.

Where Addison stands

Affordability and taxes
Proposes a $1,000 credit for every registered voter in South Carolina. He says it would help families with grocery, fuel and rent costs that he links to tariffs.
State income tax
Proposes eliminating the state income tax and raising the sales tax from 6% to 9%. He also wants to end corporate sales-tax exemptions, which he calls a loophole.
Minimum wage
Proposes raising the minimum wage to $15 an hour.
Health care access
Proposes a 'Palmetto Public Option' that would expand access to telehealth. He says employers, including small businesses, could join it at a set rate for their employees.
Two-party system
Says the Democratic and Republican parties are a 'uni-party' backed by corporations. Says the United Citizens Party represents working-class citizens.

Background

  • United Citizens Party nominee for South Carolina governor, 2026
  • Medical director with a medical practice
  • Licensed asbestos inspector; OSHA-certified property damage analyst (per campaign website, as reported by Greenville News)
  • Education: South Carolina State University; Life University
